description: Find Bitbybit API members (methods, namespaces, cloud operations) by keywords, for example "box solid" or "fillet edges". Returns dotted paths with a one-line summary, the tier (oss on npm, platform-pro only at bitbybit.dev, cloud-pro only on CAD Cloud) and the engines each is published for. Call describe with a path before writing code that uses it.

engine.description: Only members published for this engine, plus the cloud operations, which run on CAD Cloud rather than in an engine; omit for every engine

query.description: Keywords, a phrase, or a partial dotted path

version.description: The API version to search; omit for the version the server holds

name: search_api
title: Search the Bitbybit API
